text: The model flagged this applicant as high‑risk because three key signals pushed the default probability up sharply. First, the revolving‑credit utilization is essentially 100 % of the available limit; using almost all of the credit line adds the largest boost (+1.41) to the risk score, indicating the borrower is heavily dependent on credit. Second, the record shows one serious delinquency— a payment that was 90 days or more past due— which contributes another strong increase (+1.18) to the likelihood of default. Finally, the applicant is 23 years old; younger age adds a modest but still positive lift (+0.57) to the risk. Together, these factors drive the model’s 85 % default probability and the “high risk” decision.
